execution_part.Description: The instruction truncates a floating-point number to an unsigned 64-bit integer. If the conversion is successful, the result is pushed onto the stack.
The instruction attempts to truncate a floating-point number that cannot be represented as an unsigned 64-bit integer. This leads to a trap.
